items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: and it’s Richie Barnes from Willard Alexander’s office, and he said, “Buddy Rich had a heart attack out in Ann Arbor, Michigan.

ctx.x: So I get to Eddie Condon’s, my first week at Eddie Condon’s, the phone rings at lunchtime. I’m at home, I’m staying at an apartment with a friend, and it’s Richie Barnes from Willard Alexander’s office, and he said, “Buddy Rich had a heart attack out in Ann Arbor, Michigan. We need a drummer on that bandstand tonight.” I said, oh jeez. First of all Buddy didn’t have — there were no drum parts for that band because, I don’t know — it’s rumored he couldn’t read music. So here I am I said, “how are you going to get…
Isn’t that something? Yeah, he had a less personalized sound.
